text: The maximum size of a single S3 object is _____.
hint: Think about the upper limit for a single PUT or multipart upload
tip: You must use multipart upload for objects larger than 5GB. The max object size is 5TB.

text: The maximum execution time for an AWS Lambda function is _____ minutes.
hint: It was increased from 5 minutes to this value
tip: Lambda max timeout is 15 minutes (900 seconds). For longer tasks, use Step Functions or ECS.

text: RDS supports up to _____ read replicas per instance (non-Aurora).
hint: Aurora supports more, but standard RDS has a lower limit
tip: Standard RDS supports up to 5 read replicas. Aurora supports up to 15 read replicas.

text: Security Groups are _____, meaning return traffic is automatically allowed.
hint: The opposite of NACLs which are stateless
tip: Security Groups are stateful - if you allow inbound traffic, the response is automatically allowed. NACLs are stateless.

text: S3 provides _____ 9's of durability (99.999999999%).
hint: Count the nines in 99.999999999%
tip: S3 is designed for 99.999999999% (11 nines) durability across all storage classes.

text: IAM policies are written in _____ format.
hint: A lightweight data-interchange format
tip: IAM policies are JSON documents with Effect, Action, Resource, and optional Condition elements.

text: Aurora automatically replicates data _____ times across 3 AZs.
hint: 2 copies per AZ across 3 AZs
tip: Aurora stores 6 copies of your data across 3 AZs. It can lose 2 copies without affecting writes.

text: EC2 Spot Instances can save up to _____% compared to On-Demand pricing.
hint: The highest discount among EC2 pricing models
tip: Spot Instances offer up to 90% discount but can be interrupted with 2-minute notice.

text: AWS reserves _____ IP addresses in each VPC subnet.
hint: Network address, router, DNS, future, broadcast
tip: AWS reserves 5 IPs: network address, VPC router, DNS server, future use, and broadcast address.

text: The minimum storage duration for S3 Glacier Deep Archive is _____ days.
hint: Half a year
tip: Glacier Deep Archive: 180 days minimum. Glacier Flexible/Instant Retrieval: 90 days minimum.

text: AWS Shield Advanced costs _____ per month.
hint: A significant monthly cost for DDoS protection
tip: Shield Advanced costs $3,000/month and includes DDoS response team, cost protection, and Layer 7 protection.

text: DynamoDB strongly consistent reads consume _____ RCU per 4KB item.
hint: Eventually consistent reads use half of this
tip: 1 RCU = 1 strongly consistent read/s for 4KB. Eventually consistent reads use 0.5 RCU.

text: Route 53 has a _____% availability SLA.
hint: The highest possible SLA
tip: Route 53 is one of the few AWS services with a 100% availability SLA.

text: In a Spread placement group, you can have a maximum of _____ instances per AZ.
hint: A small number to ensure physical separation
tip: Spread placement groups limit 7 instances per AZ to ensure each is on different hardware.

text: EBS volumes of type gp3 have a baseline of _____ IOPS.
hint: This is independent of volume size unlike gp2
tip: gp3 provides 3,000 IOPS baseline (independent of size) and can scale up to 16,000 IOPS.

text: SQS messages can be up to _____ KB in size.
hint: Use S3 with the SQS Extended Client for larger payloads
tip: SQS max message size is 256KB. For larger messages, store in S3 and send a reference.

text: An ALB operates at Layer _____ of the OSI model.
hint: The application layer
tip: ALB = Layer 7 (HTTP/HTTPS). NLB = Layer 4 (TCP/UDP). GLB = Layer 3 (IP).

text: Aurora can auto-scale storage up to _____ TB.
hint: Over 100TB capacity
tip: Aurora storage auto-scales in 10GB increments up to 128TB with no impact to performance.

text: CloudTrail keeps _____ days of management event history by default.
hint: About 3 months
tip: CloudTrail retains 90 days of event history by default. Create a trail to store logs longer in S3.

text: EC2 Reserved Instances can save up to _____% vs On-Demand pricing.
hint: 3-year All Upfront provides the maximum discount
tip: Reserved Instances: up to 72% discount (3-year, All Upfront). Savings Plans offer similar discounts.

text: S3 _____ Replication requires versioning to be enabled on both buckets.
hint: Replicating data between different AWS regions
tip: Both CRR and SRR require versioning. CRR is for compliance, lower latency access, cross-account replication.

text: CloudWatch default metric resolution is every _____ minutes.
hint: Detailed monitoring reduces this to 1 minute
tip: Default: 5 minutes. Detailed monitoring: 1 minute. Custom metrics can go to 1-second resolution.

text: NACLs are _____, meaning you must explicitly allow return traffic.
hint: The opposite of Security Groups
tip: NACLs are stateless - you need separate inbound and outbound rules. Security Groups are stateful.

text: DynamoDB DAX provides _____ latency for cached reads.
hint: Even faster than DynamoDB's single-digit millisecond latency
tip: DAX is an in-memory cache for DynamoDB that provides microsecond latency for reads.

text: SCP stands for Service _____ Policy.
hint: These restrict what actions accounts in an Organization can perform
tip: Service Control Policies (SCPs) set maximum permissions for accounts in AWS Organizations.
